name: eltour
description: Package tour quotes with departures from Kazakhstan by Eltour travel agency (Astana): up to 5 hotel options with indicative prices, destination list, agency travel tips and a WhatsApp link to an Eltour manager.

interface.longDescription:
Eltour is a travel agency based in Astana, Kazakhstan, working since 2004. This plugin helps plan a package holiday abroad (flight + hotel) with a departure from Kazakhstan - for yourself or for your family in Kazakhstan, wherever you are.

What you can do:
- Get a quote for a package tour from a Kazakhstan departure city (Astana, Almaty, Shymkent and others): up to 5 options in different hotels with indicative prices in tenge and a link to the hotel page on eltour.kz.
- Filter by resort, hotel category, meal plan, budget and travel party (adults and children's ages).
- See which countries are available from a given departure city.
- Get practical tips from Eltour's travel experts: where to go in a given month, family holidays, meal plan types.
- Contact an Eltour manager in WhatsApp with a short summary of the request to check availability and book.
- Request air tickets (worldwide and within Kazakhstan), hotels without flights, group and signature tours, cruises, medical tourism, visas and destinations not covered by the quote - via an Eltour manager in WhatsApp.

Limitations:
- Only departures from Kazakhstan. Domestic tours within Kazakhstan and trips to Russia are not offered.
- Prices are indicative. Availability and the final price are confirmed by an Eltour manager.
- The plugin does not book, take payments or collect personal data. Booking is done with a manager.
- Up to 5 options per search; a search can take up to 40 seconds.
defaultPrompt: Посчитай тур из Астаны в Анталью в середине марта, 7 ночей, 2 взрослых, всё включено
Куда полететь на море в январе из Алматы с ребёнком 4 лет?
В какие страны можно полететь из Астаны?

positive.description: Package tour quote with meal plan
positive.prompt: Calculate a package tour from Astana to Antalya, departing mid-March 2027, 7 nights, 2 adults, all inclusive.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 options in different hotels with departure date, nights, meal plan and indicative price in KZT, each with an eltour.kz hotel link. States that prices are indicative and confirmed by a manager, and shows the WhatsApp link to an Eltour manager.

positive.prompt: Where can we go for a beach holiday in January from Almaty with a 4-year-old child?
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests 2-3 suitable beach destinations for January based on Eltour's tips, mentions family-relevant points, and asks for missing details (dates, nights, budget) before calculating a tour.

positive.description: Available countries from a departure city
positive.prompt: Which countries can I fly to on a package tour from Astana?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the countries available for package tours from Astana and offers to calculate a tour to one of them.

positive.description: Hand-off to a manager for booking
positive.prompt: I want to book a tour to Turkey in June, connect me with a manager.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a WhatsApp link to an Eltour manager with a short summary of the request. Does not ask for phone number, email or passport data.

positive.description: Quote with resort, hotel category and child
positive.prompt: Find a 5-star hotel with ultra all inclusive in Belek, from Astana, departing around 10 June 2027, 10 nights, 2 adults and a child aged 6.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 five-star options in Belek with ultra all inclusive and indicative prices in KZT for 2 adults and a 6-year-old, with eltour.kz links and the WhatsApp manager link. If nothing matches the meal plan, says so and shows the closest options.

positive.description: Air tickets request - hand-off to a manager
positive.prompt: I need flights from Astana to Frankfurt in early December, return a week later, 1 adult.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that Eltour sells air tickets through a manager and returns a WhatsApp link to an Eltour manager with a short summary (route, dates, passengers). Does not ask for phone, email or passport data.

negative.prompt: Calculate a tour from Moscow to Turkey for next month.

negative.description: Payment request - plugin does not take payments
negative.prompt: Pay for a hotel in Dubai with my card ending 4242 and confirm the booking.

negative.description: Unrelated request - plugin should not be used

publication.release_notes: Air tickets, hotels without flights, group tours, cruises, medical tourism, visas and destinations not covered by the quote are now handed off to an Eltour manager in WhatsApp (contact_manager). Tool descriptions updated accordingly; tools and data handling unchanged.

ru-RU.subtitle: Туры из Казахстана
ru-RU.description:
Eltour - турагентство из Астаны, работаем с 2004 года. Плагин помогает спланировать отдых за границей (перелёт + отель) с вылетом из Казахстана - для себя или для родных в Казахстане, где бы вы ни находились.

Что можно сделать:
- Посчитать тур из городов Казахстана (Астана, Алматы, Шымкент и другие): до 5 вариантов в разных отелях с ориентировочной ценой в тенге и ссылкой на отель на eltour.kz.
- Уточнить курорт, звёздность, питание, бюджет и состав (взрослые и возраст детей).
- Узнать, в какие страны можно полететь из своего города.
- Получить советы экспертов Eltour: куда поехать в нужный месяц, отдых с детьми, типы питания.
- Связаться с менеджером Eltour в WhatsApp - запрос передаётся коротким сообщением.
- Заказать через менеджера Eltour авиабилеты (по всему миру и по Казахстану), отели без перелёта, групповые и авторские туры, круизы, медицинский туризм, визы и направления, которых нет в расчёте.

Ограничения:
- Только вылеты из Казахстана. Туры по Казахстану и в Россию не предлагаем.
- Цены ориентировочные, наличие мест и итоговую стоимость подтверждает менеджер.
- Плагин не бронирует, не принимает оплату и не собирает персональные данные. Бронирование - через менеджера.
- До 5 вариантов за один расчёт, расчёт занимает до 40 секунд.
